summary: Re-verified RIGHT Check-In column no-scroll invariant at 1920x800 after ~6px pane-cap relaxation. Baseline (a2/a5/a1) now passes: scrollHeight == clientHeight (392 == 392), Confirm rect.bottom = 756.5 ≤ 800. Paid-upgrade scenario (a2 + Room 230 Suite upgrade + Paid) shows 23px overflow (scrollHeight 416 > clientHeight 393), but Confirm/Cancel still within viewport (bottom 761/759 ≤ 800). No JS console errors. SGST+CGST split, autoprint present/checked, B2B toggle present in LEFT Billing section. Checkout ?bill=103 shows Grand Total ₹2,677 unchanged.

Secondary: paid-upgrade scenario adds one extra line and re-introduces ~23px overflow in RIGHT ci-pane-body.
